about_the_game:
The demo version of the game allows you to partially explore one of the six locations in the full game. Discover a range of case files on Cryptids, Alien Encounters and Missing Expeditions in the forest watchtower crime scene. All progress carries over from the demo to the full-version of the game!

🧩 Mosaic of the Strange is a mystifying blend of point & click adventure and mosaic logic puzzle, on an enormous scale! Solve enormous interlocking minesweeper-like puzzles while you attempt to solve a grisly supernatural murder.

🖼️ Every region solved reveals case file details based on real-world paranormal events, strange creatures, unsolved murders, and mysterious deaths.

💣 If you know how to play Minesweeper, you already know how to play a Mega Mosaic! The numbered clues (0-9) indicate how many light tiles must be placed within 1 square of the clue.

🎶 Featuring an original soundtrack inspired by classic 90s crime thrillers.

⏳ Dozens of Hours of Addictive Gameplay: Lose yourself in hours of bewitching puzzle-solving as you explore the world of the paranormal.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game features a series of text "case files" that are based on real-world events, including:
- Unsolved murders and unusual deaths
- Alien abductions
- Hauntings
- Possessions
- Conspiracy theories
